map.按内推基数与普通岗/稀缺岗系数、人数计算分岗位激励明细，并结合推荐、录用与外部渠: Compute tiered referral incentives from the base, coefficient and headcount for general and scarce roles, then combine referral volume, hires and external channel cost to derive conversion, cost per hire and ROI.
map.单笔激励 = 内推基数 × 岗位系数；岗位激励小计 = 单笔 × 该岗位人数；激: Per-case incentive = base × role coefficient; tier subtotal = per-case × headcount; total incentive = sum of tier subtotals; conversion = hires ÷ referrals × 100%; cost per hire = total incentive ÷ hires; external channel cost = external cost per hire × hires; net saving = external channel cost − total incentive; ROI = net saving ÷ total incentive × 100%.
map.按普通岗、稀缺岗两档分别设置系数与人数，算出分岗位激励明细、转化率与单位录用成本: Set separate coefficients and headcounts for general and scarce roles to get a tiered incentive breakdown, conversion and cost per hire, then compare against external recruiting cost to judge the cost-effectiveness of the referral plan.
map.激励总额 = Σ(基数 × 岗位系数 × 该岗位人数)；单位录用成本 = 激励总: Total incentive = Σ(base × role coefficient × headcount); cost per hire = total incentive ÷ hires; ROI = (external channel cost − total incentive) ÷ total incentive.
map.基数 500 元，普通岗系数 1.0、8 人，稀缺岗系数 1.5、2 人。普通岗: Base 500 CNY, general role coefficient 1.0 with 8 hires, scarce role coefficient 1.5 with 2 hires. General subtotal 500×1.0×8 = 4000 CNY, scarce subtotal 500×1.5×2 = 1500 CNY, total incentive 5500 CNY. With 40 referrals and 10 hires, conversion is 25%, cost per hire is 5500÷10 = 550.00 CNY; at 8000 CNY external cost per hire, external total is 80000 CNY, net saving 74500 CNY, ROI 1354.55%.
map.同上但稀缺岗系数改为 2.0：稀缺岗小计 500×2.0×2=2000 元，激励: Same inputs but scarce-role coefficient raised to 2.0: scarce subtotal 500×2.0×2 = 2000 CNY, total incentive rises to 6000 CNY, cost per hire 600.00 CNY, ROI falls to 1233.33% ((80000−6000)÷6000). A higher coefficient raises the incentive total and lowers relative ROI, which helps judge whether the extra spend is worth it.
map.普遍设转正或满 3-6 月护航期，防短留即奖；本工具按一次性计发口径测算，过保口: It is common to tie the bonus to passing probation or completing a 3-6 month retention period, preventing rewards for people who leave immediately. This tool assumes a one-off payout; for a retention-window view, replace the headcount with the number who actually passed the window and recalculate. It does not roll statistics automatically.
